structure: The 2025 Asilia offering, a separate vehicle from the 2026 Asilia GC Fund. Senior secured private credit with an equity kicker. Asilia’s Fund I was described in the 2026 sessions as targeting 12-14% and tracking 14-15%, which is consistent with the 12% coupon recorded here.
provisionalNote: Terms recovered from how this deal was recorded before the 2026 offering replaced it in the file. CONFIRMED as a genuinely separate vehicle called the Asilia Debt Fund, offered 2025 — but its own numbers have not been checked against its own 2025 documents, which have not been read. The 3.27x in particular is unverified: it is also, to two decimals, what the ACFE sleeve alone produces at 16% over 8 years, so it may have been mis-attributed. If you hold the 2026 vehicle, use "Asilia GC Fund" instead.
source: Recorded terms for the earlier offering, as read by the holder. Not verified by GC.
